directedPoliticalSamples.name: 胡明恭
directedPoliticalSamples.description: 赵国易代。当时国有7城，国中不稳。赵济被俘处死，原定由赵令绍（时年39岁）承统，继统之际原赵上将军胡明恭累有取城军功，夺取王统，赵氏改为胡氏，国号由赵改为汉。新郑郡守苗怀温久任有绩，其地方治理基础为新政权所承。并易帜。国都仍在邯郸。

Profile and family DOM timings have cold-start variance. Actual offscreen 4× loops are separate from pure Core timing and cannot replace visible user acceptance. No claim of overall UI speedup or that all late-game stutter is solved.
